debrief_tips: You cannot win a lottery you never entered. An unexpected refund is usually bait.
A real refund never needs a fee, gift card, QR scan, or remote-access app.
Check refunds only inside the official app or website, never through a caller's link.
Greed and urgency are paired deliberately. Pause and verify independently.
